* Definitions

** Sigma algebra

Let \(X\) be a set. Then a family of subsets \(\Sigma \subseteq P(X)\) is called a *sigma algebra* if 

        1. \(X \in \Sigma  \)
        2. If \(A \in \Sigma \) then \(A^{c} \in  \Sigma \).
        3. Closed under countable unions
